title: Make shard weights predict CI shard wall time
body:
Outcome: shard planning predicts CI shard wall time, so the slowest Test step drops below 24 s.
Evidence: after #344 (t-xwnd81m) the 8-shard plan is balanced at 45.6-45.7 weighted s, yet main run 42424391336 Test steps were 16-30 s (42420551206: 11-26 s; 42423998544: 15-24 s). Summed per-file medians do not predict shard wall (in-shard concurrency, setup, runner noise).
Acceptance: a script prints predicted vs actual per-shard Test step for the last 5 main runs with a correlation verdict; if weak, the weight model changes (e.g. per-shard wall regression or max-file bound) and the slowest Test step p50 over 5 runs is below 24 s.
